text:
GENERATE BURST CS-cloudtex-a — painted CLOUD-BANK TEXTURE for the cliffside canyon (Matt: cliff undersides must not be transparent; R-C3-69). task_id "CS-cloudtex-a".

Paint ONE 1536×1024 image that is ENTIRELY filled, edge to edge, with a dense, opaque bank of billowing valley cumulus seen from above at a high three-quarter angle, lit by a warm SUNSET from the UPPER-LEFT: rose-peach and warm cream on the lit billow tops, soft lavender and dusky violet in the shadowed valleys between billows, a few thin wisps. Hand-painted 2D in the level's style (IMAGE 1 is the approved painted cliff and cloud look — match its cloud rendering, palette and brushwork, not its layout): painted cloud forms with soft but readable shapes, bold jewel tones, no photo texture.
CONSTRAINTS: no sky, no ground, no rock, no trees, no horizon, no empty gaps — clouds fill 100 % of the frame; billows are roughly uniform in scale across the frame (each billow head ~120–260 px wide), no single dominant feature; the LEFT and RIGHT edges must tile seamlessly (the leftmost columns continue the rightmost columns); even overall brightness from top to bottom (no vignette, no gradient to dark). No characters, text, UI, border.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if the frame is not fully filled with clouds, a sky/horizon/ground appears, or the left/right edges clearly do not tile — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/cloudtex_a.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-cloudtex-a"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — approved painted cliff + cloud look (style only)
